svg.metadata: {"title": "Text", "description": "A title and text, wrapped to the paper's width; on the roll, as long as it needs.", "fields": {"title": {"default": "", "help": "bold, over the text (empty: none)"}, "text": {"default": "Hello", "help": "wrapped; new lines kept"}, "size": {"default": "4", "help": "text size, mm"}, "footer": {"default": "", "help": "small, under it"}}, "example": {"title": "Note", "text": "Oat milk, coffee filters and the 2.5 mm hex key.", "footer": "from the kitchen tablet"}}
